description: Office of the Public Service Commission - Public Service Commission Delegation of Powers by the Public Service Commission in terms of Article 57(1) of the Constitution
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the delegation of powers by the Public Service Commission regarding the appointment, confirmation, and retirement of officers in the Sri Lanka Principals' Service. The content is specifically about public service administration, recruitment procedures, and the exercise of powers by a public service body, which aligns perfectly with the definition of a Public Service Gazette (Type 8). It does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or fit any of the other specialized categories (4-7, 9).
